title: Eleventeen M12 Art Tidbits. Also, Plants!

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who turned against and defeated Tezzeret and became de facto leader of the Infinite Consortium's Ravnica cell.

entities.name: Tezzeret

events.summary: Jace turns against and defeats Tezzeret, then becomes de facto leader of the Consortium's Ravnica cell and puts its resources to work.

events.quote: the scroll Jace was hired to recover that later led both Planeswalkers fatefully to the Eye of Ugin on Zendikar
